user.title: Fuel Finder API and Search Setup
user.description: Choose how to set your search location and enter your Fuel Finder API credentials. You can create your Client ID and Client Secret via the UK Government Fuel Finder guidance: https://www.developer.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk/public-api

data.search_method: How would you like to set your search area?

location_map.title: Configure Fuel Prices UK - Map
location_map.description: Monitor fuel prices at stations near you. This integration uses official UK government fuel price data to find the cheapest prices within your specified radius.

data.max_data_age_days: Ignore Prices Older Than (in days, 0 = no day limit)

data_description.update_interval: How often to check for updated fuel prices (minimum 5 minutes)
data_description.location: Your location for finding nearby fuel stations
data_description.radius: Maximum distance to search for fuel stations (0.5 to 31 miles)
data_description.fuel_types: Which fuel types to track prices for
data_description.cheapest_count: How many ranked cheapest stations to expose per fuel type (0 disables cheapest sensors)
data_description.nearest_count: How many distance-ranked (nearest first) stations to expose per fuel type (0 disables nearest sensors)
data_description.max_data_age_days: Skip stations whose price data is older than this many days. Set 0 to include all data regardless of age.

stale_data.title: Fuel Prices UK data has not updated recently
stale_data.description: The Fuel Finder API has failed for the last {failure_count} consecutive refresh attempts (first failure: {since}). Displayed fuel prices may be out of date. Check the Home Assistant logs for `custom_components.fuel_prices_uk` for details on why the refresh is failing. This repair clears automatically once a refresh succeeds.
